title: CPU screening latency feasibility for a two-stage classifier
query_selection: First 1024 development-test feature fingerprints ordered by SHA256(seed|fingerprint); no query labels or prediction scores used
screen_target: 0=NormalTraffic,1=any other registered stage; same192 selected training records as E1 seed20260921
gbdt_selection: E1 exact three-fold stratified CV and three-candidate grids on same192 selected rows; XGBoost then LightGBM ties; no held-out selection
timing: Fitted imputer.transform plus actual model.predict_proba on one1024-row batch; independent fit/constructor timers; no precalculated probabilities
primary_statistic: Median of three screen-alone times versus median full-stage selected-GBDT time divided by5
success_interpretation: Passing is necessary only, never sufficient, for fivefold serial-cascade throughput at this frozen CPU configuration
failure_interpretation: CPU candidate fails necessary speed condition; GPU implementation, other settings, screen quality, and full end-to-end frontier remain untested
partial_execution_policy: Any nonempty output directory is preserved and rejected; fresh output required
source_scope: Feature-deduplicated within-author-training development split; no incident/temporal/author-holdout generalization claim
